hunks.baseline: The System had told me circulating qi could detoxify, too.
hunks.sol: According to the System, circulating my qi could detoxify me, too.

hunks.sol:

>

hunks.baseline: Following the formula of the Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique, I guided my internal energy. The moment I started circulating qi, the headache began to fade. After about ten minutes, the message I’d been waiting for appeared.
hunks.sol: Following the formula of the Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique, I guided my internal energy. The moment I started circulating my qi, the headache began to fade. After about ten minutes, the message I’d been waiting for appeared.

hunks.baseline:
> **System**
>
> Hangover disappears.
hunks.sol:
> **System**
>
> - Hangover has disappeared.

hunks.baseline: But I didn’t stop. I knew that wrapping it up halfway through would tank the efficiency.
hunks.sol: But I didn’t stop. I knew that ending the session abruptly midway would reduce the efficiency of the circulation.

hunks.baseline: I didn’t uncross my legs until a full hour had passed. My head was clear, and my body was bursting with energy.
hunks.sol: I didn’t uncross my legs until a full hour had passed. My head was clear, and my body brimmed with energy.

hunks.baseline: *Why is so little energy coming in?*
hunks.sol: *Why is so little qi coming in?*

hunks.baseline: Internal energy only increased if you took in qi from outside, stored it, and circulated it. But my first circulation in reality brought in strangely little.
hunks.sol: To increase my internal energy, I had to draw in qi from outside, store it within myself, and circulate it. But my first attempt at circulating qi in reality had brought in strangely little.

hunks.baseline: *And it’s murky, too.*
hunks.sol: *And it’s impure, too.*

hunks.baseline: It was like a tiny serving of bland food—and even that took forever to arrive. I frowned.
hunks.sol: It was like getting a tiny serving of bland food after waiting forever for it. I frowned.

hunks.baseline: Internal energy was based on pure natural qi, so it was possible. Compared to Murim, the natural environment of modern society was in pretty dire shape.
hunks.sol: Internal energy was based on the pure qi of nature, so it was possible. Compared to Murim, the natural environment of modern society was in pretty dire shape.

hunks.baseline: A one-room in a goshiwon built decades ago was hardly a nature-friendly place. It stank, and the facilities were old.
hunks.sol: A one-room in a goshiwon built decades ago was hardly an environmentally friendly place. It stank, and the facilities were ancient.

hunks.baseline: Jinho hyung was always suspicious of what this place really was, and he was the goshiwon manager.
hunks.sol: Jinho hyung was always suspicious of what this place had originally been, and he was the goshiwon manager.

hunks.baseline: *Maybe it used to be a torture chamber. During the Great Cataclysm they probably dragged monsters in, tapped their balls with a knife, and asked where the Demon King was. The monsters would’ve given up his parents’ location, too.*
hunks.sol: *Maybe it used to be a torture chamber. During the Great Cataclysm, they probably dragged monsters in, tapped their balls with a knife, and asked where the Demon King was. The monsters would’ve given up his parents’ location, too.*

hunks.baseline: *He should be sleeping by now, right?*
hunks.sol: *He should be asleep right now, shouldn’t he?*

hunks.baseline: He treated getting up in the morning as a disgrace, so there was no need to check. I was wondering whether to go grab breakfast when—
hunks.sol: He considered getting up in the morning a disgrace, so there was no need to check. I was wondering whether to go grab breakfast when—

hunks.baseline: 〈 Luxury Nutjob
Luxury Nutjob
Do you have some time?
hunks.sol:
> **Designer-Brand Junkie**
>
> Do you have some time?

hunks.baseline: The sender was Luxury Nutjob—or rather, Team Leader Choi.
hunks.sol: The sender was Designer-Brand Junkie—or rather, Team Leader Choi.

hunks.baseline: A glittering chandelier. Stylishly dressed people, and soft classical music in the background.
hunks.sol: A glittering chandelier. Stylishly dressed people. Soft classical music playing in the background.

hunks.baseline: I couldn’t tell if the meeting place was a café or a high-end restaurant.
hunks.sol: I couldn’t tell whether the meeting place was a café or a high-end restaurant.

hunks.baseline: Model proportions, and a face like a handsome Greek god.
hunks.sol: He had a model’s proportions and the face of a handsome Greek god.

hunks.baseline: While I was having an identity crisis, Team Leader Choi calmly started ordering.
hunks.sol: While I was having an identity crisis, Team Leader Choi calmly began ordering.

hunks.baseline: Something about the vibe said I shouldn’t order a caramel macchiato.
hunks.sol: Something about the atmosphere said I shouldn’t order a caramel macchiato.

hunks.baseline: The coffee that came out a little later was pretty decent.
hunks.sol: The coffee that arrived a little later was pretty decent.

hunks.baseline: Even after hearing it, I still had no idea what that meant. I just went, well, okay then.
hunks.sol: Even after hearing it, I still had no idea what that meant. I just thought, *Well, okay, then.*

hunks.baseline: I muttered my honest take.
hunks.sol: I gave him my honest opinion.

hunks.baseline: I quietly set down my cup. Team Leader Choi chuckled, then spoke.
hunks.sol: I quietly set down my cup. Team Leader Choi let out a short laugh, then spoke.

hunks.baseline: “You’re fast. It’s personal information—the Association wouldn’t have opened all of it.”
hunks.sol: “You’re fast. It’s personal information, so the Association wouldn’t have made all of it public.”

hunks.baseline: “C-rank reawakened Hunters are rare. Besides, I saw what happened yesterday with my own eyes. There was no way I wouldn’t know.”
hunks.sol: “C-rank reawakened Hunters are rare. Besides, I saw what happened yesterday with my own eyes. How could I not know?”

hunks.baseline: That was true.
hunks.sol: He had a point.

hunks.baseline: As I granted him that, Team Leader Choi held something out. A single envelope, laid neatly on the table.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi held something out to me. A single envelope, laid neatly on the table.

hunks.baseline: I checked the contents. Instead of a check, tiny printed letters packed the page.
hunks.sol: I checked the contents. Instead of a check, I found lines of tiny print packed across the pages.

hunks.baseline: “The best terms our Guild can offer. Give it a read.”
hunks.sol: “These are the best terms our Guild can offer. Give it a read.”

hunks.baseline: I was already reading it. From the first line to the last. Every clause was another shock.
hunks.sol: I was already reading it, from the first line to the last. Every clause brought another shock.

hunks.baseline: After about seven years knocking around this business, I’d seen plenty, and overheard plenty more.
hunks.sol: After knocking around this business for about seven years, I’d seen plenty and overheard plenty more.

hunks.baseline: “They’re good terms even among B-rank contracts.”
hunks.sol: “They’d be considered good terms even for a B-rank Hunter.”

hunks.baseline: “Then why are you offering this to me…?”
hunks.sol: “Then why are you offering them to me…?”

hunks.baseline: “Because they trust me.”
hunks.sol: “Because I trust myself.”

hunks.baseline: “They trust my instincts, and they trust my eye for people. That’s why I want to hold on to Jin Taekyung.”
hunks.sol: “I trust my instincts, and I trust my eye for people. That’s why I want you on board, Mr. Jin Taekyung.”

hunks.baseline: It wasn’t only the terms. Someone had recognized me and wanted me this badly. I wanted to nod right then.
hunks.sol: It wasn’t only the terms. Someone had recognized me and wanted me this badly. That alone made me want to nod right then and there.

hunks.baseline: That was why today’s hesitation ran longer than yesterday’s. By the time I finally decided, the coffee had gone cold.
hunks.sol: That was why I hesitated longer today than I had yesterday. By the time I finally reached a decision, the coffee had gone cold.

hunks.baseline: I was grateful for the offer, but… I couldn’t rush this.
hunks.sol: I was grateful for the offer, but… I couldn’t afford to rush this.

hunks.baseline: “Time.”
hunks.sol: “Time…”

hunks.baseline: “This is my second offer.”
hunks.sol: “Here’s my second offer.”

hunks.baseline: Another envelope came out of Team Leader Choi’s jacket. Still dazed, I took it and checked the contents.
hunks.sol: Another envelope emerged from inside Team Leader Choi’s jacket. Still dazed, I accepted it and checked the contents.

hunks.baseline: I did. I knew it well.
hunks.sol: Of course. I knew it well.

hunks.baseline: If the Manpower Office was day labor, a provisional contract with a Guild was temp work. You’d be attached to the Guild for a short stretch, basically a mercenary.
hunks.sol: If working through the Hunter Manpower Office was day labor, a provisional contract with a Guild was temp work. You joined the Guild for a short period and worked as a kind of mercenary.

hunks.baseline: It was less generous than the formal contract he’d given me, but it was still more than generous enough. And the part that mattered most to me—the contract period—was a blank.
hunks.sol: It was less generous than the formal contract he’d given me, but it was still more than generous enough. Better yet, the part that mattered most to me—the contract period—had been left blank.

hunks.baseline: I took the pen he held out, half in a daze.
hunks.sol: I took the pen he held out, still half in a daze.

hunks.baseline: After thinking it over, I wrote seven days. A week should be enough time to see whether the System would last.
hunks.sol: After thinking it over, I wrote seven days. A week should be enough time to see whether the System would remain.

hunks.baseline: When we shook hands firmly, it sank in that I’d taken my first step as a C-rank-level Hunter.
hunks.sol: As we shook hands firmly, it finally sank in that I had taken my first step as a C-rank Hunter.

hunks.baseline: “Starting now.”
hunks.sol: “You start now.”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi’s car was a large military vehicle. He looked like the type to collect expensive supercars, so this was unexpected. I only understood why after we arrived at the Gate.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi’s car was a massive military vehicle. He looked like the type to collect expensive supercars, so the choice surprised me. I only understood why after we arrived at the Gate.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi pressed a small button, and a trunk large enough for five grown men to lie down in appeared.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi pressed a small button, revealing a trunk large enough for five grown men to lie down in.

hunks.baseline: “I had it modified for work. Leaving all this at home felt kind of off.”
hunks.sol: “I had it modified for work. Keeping all of this at home felt a little awkward.”

hunks.baseline: Gear worth at least several million won was stacked and sorted. Armor and weapons were a given. Potions of every kind, even disposable magic scrolls people said were too expensive to actually use. He had everything.
hunks.sol: Pieces of equipment worth millions of won apiece had been carefully stacked and sorted. Armor and weapons were just the beginning. There were all kinds of potions, even disposable magic scrolls people said were too expensive to actually use. He had everything.

hunks.baseline: “For now. Some of it was gifts, and some I bought because it looked nice.”
hunks.sol: “For now. Some were gifts, and some I bought because they looked nice.”

hunks.baseline: Ah. So he buys gear because it looks nice.
hunks.sol: Ah. So he bought equipment because it looked nice.

hunks.baseline: C-rank Hunters made good money, but Team Leader Choi’s spending was already beyond that. He must have been rich enough that money was never a concern.
hunks.sol: C-rank Hunters made good money, but Team Leader Choi’s spending was already on another level. He must have been rich enough that money had never been a concern.

hunks.baseline: “It might be better to rent from a rental shop. If I borrow something and it gets wrecked, it’d be kind of…”
hunks.sol: “I think I’d rather rent from an equipment shop. If I borrowed something from you and it got damaged, I’d feel…”

hunks.baseline: Ah. So he even cares whether gear is in fashion.
hunks.sol: Ah. So he even cared whether equipment was fashionable.

hunks.baseline: I gave up thinking about it around there and picked my equipment.
hunks.sol: At that point, I gave up trying to understand him and started choosing my gear.

hunks.baseline: Anyone watching would think I had a lizardman fetish.
hunks.sol: Anyone watching would think I had a lizard fetish.

hunks.baseline: With the spear as the last piece, I was done choosing. Team Leader Choi chuckled.
hunks.sol: With the spear as the final piece, I was done choosing my equipment. Team Leader Choi let out a short laugh.

hunks.baseline: “I was thinking things are going well.”
hunks.sol: “I was thinking that things are going well.”

hunks.baseline: I had no idea what he meant, but I followed him to the front of the Gate. Instead of an Administration staffer, some man was standing there.
hunks.sol: I had no idea what he meant, but I followed him to the Gate. Instead of an Administration employee, some man was standing there.

hunks.baseline: A perfectly proper ninety-degree bow. Even more surprising was the way Team Leader Choi took it as natural.
hunks.sol: He bowed at a perfect ninety-degree angle. Even more surprising was the way Team Leader Choi accepted it as completely natural.

hunks.baseline: The term was an honorific for an unmarried younger brother-in-law, but there was no way that man was Team Leader Choi’s sister-in-law…
hunks.sol: The term was normally used by a woman for her husband’s unmarried younger brother, but there was no way that man was Team Leader Choi’s sister-in-law…

hunks.baseline: *Team Leader Choi. So he was a rich family’s young master.*
hunks.sol: *Team Leader Choi was the young master of some rich family.*

hunks.baseline: I should have known from the moment I saw him dripping in luxury gear from head to toe.
hunks.sol: I should have known from the moment I saw him decked out in designer equipment from head to toe.

hunks.baseline: Add being fashion-conscious enough to care about equipment design, and you couldn’t pull that off unless you were one hell of a gold spoon.
hunks.sol: Add in the fact that he was enough of a fashionista to care about equipment design, and there was no way he hadn’t been born with one hell of a gold spoon in his mouth.

hunks.baseline: The guy who had everything turned to me.
hunks.sol: The man who had everything turned to me.

hunks.baseline: Me, Team Leader Choi, and some middle-aged guy I didn’t know. That was everyone.
hunks.sol: There was me, Team Leader Choi, and some middle-aged man I’d never seen before. That was everyone.

hunks.baseline: “They’re right here. The team members.”
hunks.sol: “The team member is right here.”

hunks.baseline: “Oh, I see. He’s going in too, right?”
hunks.sol: “Oh, right. He’s going in too, then?”

hunks.baseline: The middle-aged man cut in, his voice heavy.
hunks.sol: The middle-aged man cut in, his voice deep.

hunks.baseline: Look at how decisive he was. Who was he, Pocheongcheon?[^2]
hunks.sol: Look at how firm he was. Who was he, Pocheongcheon?[^2]

hunks.baseline: “I’ve been to plenty.”
hunks.sol: “I’ve been through plenty.”

hunks.baseline: A safe raid on a D-rank Gate needed a team of ten Hunters of the same rank. I could use the System, and I’d learned martial arts, but that didn’t make the danger go away.
hunks.sol: A safe raid on a D-rank Gate required a team of ten D-rank Hunters. I could use the System, and I had learned martial arts, but that didn’t make every danger disappear.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi went on in a relaxed voice.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi continued in a relaxed voice.

hunks.baseline: “C-rank was the rank I received when I was first measured. The reawakening happened afterward.”
hunks.sol: “C-rank was what I received when I was first measured. My reawakening happened afterward.”

hunks.baseline: Meaning he was at least B-rank in ability.
hunks.sol: Meaning he had the ability of at least a B-rank Hunter.

hunks.baseline: The odds were slim, but he could be even higher than that.
hunks.sol: The odds were slim, but he could be even higher.

hunks.baseline: If that was true, the situation changed. Just the two of us also meant a bigger cut for me.
hunks.sol: If that was true, the situation changed. And with just the two of us, my cut would be that much bigger.

hunks.baseline: “If you want to go back, I won’t stop you. I can go in alone. It wouldn’t be the first time, or the second.”
hunks.sol: “If you want to leave, I won’t stop you. I can go in alone. It wouldn’t be the first or second time.”

hunks.baseline: He walked in and out of D-rank Gates alone on the regular?
hunks.sol: He went in and out of D-rank Gates alone on a regular basis?

hunks.baseline: “Then be careful in there. From tomorrow, we’ll look at E-rank.”
hunks.sol: “Then be careful in there. Starting tomorrow, we’ll stick to E-rank Gates.”
